model.name: esports-player-projections-v2
model.note: Each projection starts from that player's own rate in his earlier games, newest weighted most and pulled toward the field when he has few. It then moves with the opponent: each team is rated from its earlier results, and a player's count rises or falls with how his side is expected to do against this opponent compared with how it usually did. CS2 is per map, per round times the rounds that matchup is expected to run, with maps 1 and 2 together for a best of three. Dota 2 and League of Legends are per game. The displayed game is never part of its own projection. Ranges are calibrated on the same players' earlier games so 8 in 10 results land inside. No posted line or price is used.
